notes.title: Builders of Greece Now in Full Release!🏛️⚒️
notes.notes:
[h2]Rule👑Build ⚒️Thrive🌿[/h2]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/][b]Builders of Greece[/b][/url] is now in Full Release with a Major Update🔥[/h3]

[previewyoutube=W_fSaZQGj7M;full][/previewyoutube]

We're absolutely thrilled to share some fantastic news with our amazing Builders of Greece community. After a few months of hard work, dedication, and feedback from our incredible players, [b]Builders of Greece is officially graduating from Early Access[/b]! 🚀



All those who still haven't bought Builders of Greece, now you can get it as a full game with a [b]50% launch discount[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/


[h3][b]What's New?[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Building over time
[*] New scenario
[*] New map
[*] Decree system
[*] Economy panel
[*] Trade system
[*] Quick view of the most important building information
[*] Other gods - Demeter, Hephaestus, Hades, Ares
[*] New buildings
[*] More building animations
[*] Lots of balance changes, fixes, QoL and general improvement of the game quality
[*] More citizens on the city streets
[/list]

[h3][b]Thank You, Builder![/b][/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who participated in the Early Access phase. Your passion, bug reports, and creative ideas have been invaluable in shaping Builders of Greece into the game it is today. We couldn't have done it without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/dff598d16e7a6fd21e9139c26576ae02be420b57.png[/img]

[h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3]
The journey doesn't end here! We're committed to continually supporting Builders of Greece with regular updates, bug fixes, and possibly even more exciting content based on your ongoing feedback.

Thank you for joining us on this building adventure.

Lead your people 👥, craft your legacy 📜, and shape history 🏺!


⚒️Happy building⚒️
Builders of Greece Development Team🏗️

notes.title: Daily Deal and New Patch are HERE! 🤩
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Today, our messengers bring you not one, but [b]two great news regarding your flourishing empire.[/b] The first one will certainly be of interest to new rulers who have not yet tried their hand at leading an ancient city, while the second one will for sure please all those who already know the hardships of ruling.

Let's start with [b]the first one[/b], shall we?


[h2]Take advantage of a unique -40% discount 👀[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/8071987436750b26e350e5133efa9de74f3c0c99.png[/img]

[b]From this very moment until August 8[/b] you can start your amazing ancient adventure with a -4️⃣0️⃣% discount. This is a perfect occasion to sit on the throne of your own settlement, which over time will evolve into a huge metropolis. See for yourself how [b]satisfying, enjoyable and challenging[/b] it is to exercise such great power! 

Spread the word among your fellow rulers and be sure to let them know that [b]-40% discount[/b] has just kicked off. The ancient world offers a place for anyone eager to lead their own city!


[h2]The new Patch 0.9.0 and its awesome features 🛠️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
On the occasion of the Daily Deal, we also decided to [b]make happy[/b] those who already own their copy of Builders of Greece. And what makes you happier than [b]a nice surprise?[/b] 😁

Based on your feedback and suggestions, as well as our own observations, we managed to implement several important features that [b]we know you've been waiting for[/b]. Those of you who remember our Content RoadMap will surely notice that some of them coincide with the changes we planned for [b]the "Great People" Milestone[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/d4cd093944fa056f76876e3160bb3e8843e6330c.gif[/img]

That being said, you can treat today's Patch as a [b]prelude to this significant phase[/b] 🤓 Of course, the "Great People" Milestone will still receive previously planned extensions such as iconic figures of the ancient world, new events, new economic panel and new maps.

[b]Ok, with that behind us, let's cut to the chase! [/b]


[h3]Check out the new Patch 0.9.0 Notes:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
• Added an option to relocate existing buildings
• Improvements to the decoration system:
- decorations now affect the happiness of your citizens
- decorations can now be placed freely and are not affected by the building grid system
• New Sandbox map 
• Resolving a number of bugs and issues reported by the community
• Number of QoL changes:
- improvements to the warehouse and storage system
- locating buildings placed in the city via right-clicking them in the building panel


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7984b915c5c2391bb1921e2305c9705fc3b2d240.gif[/img]

We can't wait to see your [b]renovated, rearranged and beautifully decorated cities![/b] 😍 We hope that the changes introduced will make the gameplay even more fun and engaging. As always, [b]we await your feedback[/b] on our Discord server and Social Media channels.

Ok, Builders, we wish you a great day and many, many awesome adventures in [b]the Early Access version[/b] of the game 🖐️ May the Gods favor you!

notes.title: The latest Patch - Blessing of Olympus - is now LIVE ⚡
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If you've seen our new [b]Early Access Content RoadMap[/b], you probably know that today, Builders of Greece will welcome some very special guests. Some of them are kind and caring, others do not shy away from violence... and all of them, without exception, are [b]extremely powerful![/b]

Without them, the culture and development of [b]Ancient Greece would not have been the same[/b]. And it's not just about wonderful temples, altars, or the godsfearing everyday life of all social classes 🙏 Shared beliefs helped cement communities, making it easier for them to work together and [b]pursue common goals.[/b] You and your subjects must also stand before the Gods to gain their favor... or ignite their wrath. [b]And so - let's welcome them to your Polis![/b]


[h2]It's time to meet your Patrons 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All of the Gods will gladly accept your prayers and appreciation. However, to effectively demonstrate your devotion, [b]you must first prepare an appropriate place.[/b] Religious buildings are perfect for this purpose, the first of which is the Altar. Once the [b]Altar[/b] or other building of this kind finds its place in your city, you will gain access to the new panel shown below 👇

[i](Click to expand)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6cb4872876c6c94fd2d777dc354612c8900e966c.png[/img]

In the Faith panel, you can see the [b]satisfaction of individual Gods[/b] and learn how they can help you with their favors. Each of the religious buildings can be dedicated to one of the Patrons, and it is up to you to forge your own mortals-to-Gods strategy! 

Will your Polis become a [b]place of worship[/b], or will you satisfy them with the[b] bare minimum?[/b] Will you commit to one particular God, or will you try to be on good terms with them all? 🤔 [b]The decision is yours alone[/b], and each choice will have its consequences... To make your task easier, we have prepared a short cheat sheet!

[h3]Each God excels in a specific area[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
🏹 [b]Artemis[/b] - Goddess of hunt, wild nature, moon and animals - thanks to her support, your ranged units will be more efficient in battle, and your Hunter's Hut will produce more meat

💕 [b]Aphrodite[/b] - Goddess of love, beauty and desire - with her help, your population will grow and reproduce faster, providing you with a stable influx of new subjects

🍇 [b]Dionysus[/b] - God of wine, theater and ecstasy - through his passion for celebration, he will help you prepare important rituals that other Gods will surely appreciate

🔥 [b]Hephaestus[/b] - God of fire and craftsmanship - thanks to his divine endurance and strength, Hephaestus improves the combat potential of your infantry units

😇 [b]Hestia[/b] - Goddess of family, travelers and newborns - her kindness and caring nature strengthens the bonds between the inhabitants of your city and allows more of them to fit under the roof of one house


[h2]Rituals and the fury of the Gods ⚡[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7bd7add01b9b4ac5f97c72297e246911368639b3.gif[/img]

The most effective way to win a God's favor is by [b]performing special rituals[/b] in a dedicated place of worship. Preparing such rituals is often time-consuming and can be expensive, as the appropriate goods are needed to carry them out. Nevertheless, as you already know, [b]it is a profitable investment.[/b] Especially since ignoring the jealous Ancient Gods is not a good idea...

[h3]The Gods can show their displeasure in various ways - and none of them are good for your city! 😱 Angry Patrons may, for example:[/h3]

• scare animals away from your hunting grounds
• cause a plague of infertility
• spark off the degradation of tools and valuable items
• turn other divine beings against your Polis
• cause random houses to fall into ruin... 

And unfortunately, there may be more such negative effects! ☠️ With that in mind, be sure to carefully [b]plan your relationships with the inhabitants of Olympus[/b].


[h2]Improvements to the Technology system 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the introduction of the Faith system is the biggest change in today's Patch, [b]it is not the only one.[/b] Based on your feedback, we also decided to make a number of changes to another very important feature of the game, namely the [b]Technology system. [/b]

An overhaul of the Technology system is aimed at increasing its influence on the game throughout its course 🧐 This means that your [b]development decisions will now have an even greater impact[/b] on how your entire Polis performs. [b]Moreover[/b], from now on you have the possibility to choose the development path that [b]best suits you[/b], which was not so strongly emphasized before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/f5d2cb0443434c2b834469309a84a6eb32960793.gif[/img]

More specifically, the Technology system has been divided into two kinds of perks: [b]basic and elite[/b] ⭐ The first of them is necessary to push your city forward, while the latter will show their full potential in the mid and late game. [b]Thanks to precisely adjusted gradation[/b], elite perks will affect areas such as various production modifiers or the improvement of combat units.


[h2]New Maps 🗺️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you, eager for new challenges, asked about new maps. We have done our best to fulfill this request, and so... we're happy to announce that with today's update, [b]two new unexplored lands have appeared in Sandbox mode[/b]! And this is by no means the end - we will soon present you with even more maps, both in Scenario and Sandbox modes. [b]Explorers, rejoice![/b] 😁

[b]• Olympus Island[/b] - land of plateaus and plains, with a few gentle descents to the blue sea. A perfect place to build a vast, powerful Polis stretching to the horizon. If you dream of a city built at different heights, this place is just perfect.

[b]• Hera Island[/b] - this unique island boasts a long, straight shoreline that can be used for maritime trade and fishing. Inland stretches a vast plain, the edges of which are marked by high, inaccessible yet majestic mountains.

Thank you for your time, Builders! We wish you many new awesome adventures in the mystical world of Ancient Greece. [b]May the Gods bless you all! [/b]🙏

notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In recent days, you've generously provided us with a [b]wealth [/b]of valuable feedback and opinions. This input has significantly enhanced our comprehension of the challenges you encountered while playing the Prologue and made it easier for us to further improve our game. Many, many thanks for that, Rulers! 🤝


[h3]If you want to share your feedback in a quick and easy way, be sure to fill the 👉 [url=https://forms.gle/RAPdk4kqbRYNxhEq5]Prologue Feedback From[/url] [/h3]


Thanks to your reports, we were able to implement important hotfixes, which, as we believe, solve the majority of the issues you told us about. So far, we have prepared [b]two updates[/b], which should make your Builders of Greece adventure even more fun and immersive, however, if the need arises (and you express such a desire), we will be happy to continue in this direction. All in all, it is your opinions that are most important here, right? 🤓 And now - it's time to get [b]to the point.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/a93d77d45b9a1554f8ad14616023c35a725d7eb6.png[/img]


[h2]What's new in the Builders of Greece: Prologue - the two last hotfixes changelogs[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*] Theater saving, destroying, and rebuilding is now working properly in all tiers 
[*] Stone roads now take Drachmas instead of giving Drachmas
[*] Stone roads are now saving properly 
[*] Saving while being in the "destroy mode" doesn't destroy your other buildings anymore 
[*] Minor UI fixes
[*] Streamer mode, with carefully selected tracks that should not trigger any copyright claims, is now available
[*] Main menu overhaul
[*] Small production rebalance
[*] Tooltips are now more readable
[*] Notifications & icons update, now should be more informative about state of your Polis
[*] Keybind fixes
[*] Mouse inversion is now possible
[*] Minor localization fixes
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
- (Only if you load your save from previous version) - you can complete building of the Theater much sooner than it should be possible.

[hr][/hr]
As always, we remain at your disposal on our [b]Social Media, Discord server and Steam Discussions[/b] channels! 📢

notes.notes:

Theather saving, destroying and rebuilding is now working properly in all tiers.
Stone roads now take Drachmas instead of giving Drachmas
Stone roads are now saving properly
Saving while being in destroy mode doesn't destroy your buildings anymore
Minor UI fixes
 Known issues:
